edges.reason: Owner is initialised from msg.sender in the Owned constructor.
BurnToken enforces require(owner == msg.sender), an authorization check on caller input.
transfer reads and debits balances[msg.sender].
transferFrom reads allowed[from][msg.sender] as the spender allowance.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and passes msg.sender to the callee.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
Owned constructor writes owner = msg.sender.
Token constructor overwrites owner with the _owner argument.
Constructor mints the fixed supply into _totalSupply.
Constructor credits balances[owner] with the whole supply.
transferOwnership stores the pending owner in newOwner.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on msg.sender == owner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner to owner.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0).
totalSupply reads _totalSupply through SafeMath.sub.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)].
balanceOf returns balances[tokenOwner].
transfer debits the sender and credits the recipient in balances.
transfer uses SafeMath.sub for the sender balance.
transfer uses SafeMath.add for the recipient balance.
approve writes the allowance into allowed.
transferFrom moves balances between from and to.
transferFrom decrements the granted allowance in allowed.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub on balances and allowance.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.add for the recipient balance.
allowance returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall stores the allowance before calling the spender.
approveAndCall performs an external call into spender.receiveApproval, letting the callee re-enter with the freshly granted allowance.
BurnToken reads and zeroes balances[_from].
BurnToken reduces _totalSupply by the burned value.
BurnToken performs the raw subtraction balances[_from] -= _value without SafeMath.
BurnToken performs the raw subtraction _totalSupply -= _value without SafeMath.
transferAnyERC20Token calls an arbitrary token contract's transfer, allowing a malicious callee to re-enter.
The rescued tokens are sent to the owner address.
